svg.text: Cut list (centre to centre lengths are in the build plan, Table 2):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side rails 2 x 1,125; front risers 2 x 442; caster arms 2 x 408,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: angled 8.6 degrees outward; lower cross member 610 and upper

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cross member 670 (40 x 30 x 1.2); hip sleeves 2 x 467 (30 x 30).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build it upside down on a flat floor: rail centres 640 apart,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square to the lower cross member; check the diagonals agree.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Risers stand on the rails at their front ends; the upper cross

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: member sits on the riser tops; caster arms butt on its front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face over each riser and are coped to the head tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head tubes upright, 770 apart, 1,590 ahead of the rear axle line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sleeves stand on the rail ends, rear faces flush with the rail ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the receiver plate on the upper cross member, the pin guides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the caster arms, the guard tabs on the rails, the sensor tab.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: posts slide in the sleeves; head tubes parallel.
